description: Everybody in a wave moves one place along it at the same time.

walkthrough.line: Everybody moves one place along the box at the same time.
walkthrough.teach: The larks walk straight across the set, passing right shoulders, and land one place along. The robins loop out of their own line and back into it one place along, going round to the {hand}. Everybody moves at once, and you end in the wave you started in with different dancers beside you.
